Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with latency and the cost controls you showed. We are interested in running a cross-division pilot (platform + analytics + product) for ~6 months and would like to purchase via AWS Marketplace private offer so we can centralize procurement.

High-level ask: a private offer covering up to $120,000 over 6 months with pilot pricing and co-sell engagement. Our buyer team will need:
- A private-offer URL we can accept in our AWS console
- A formal invoice/PO flow; we typically run Net45 but can discuss

I'm attaching our PO template (BrightForge_PO_Template.pdf). Can you confirm: whether a single private offer can cover multiple BrightForge legal entities / divisions and what buyer approvals are required on our side?

I'll loop in procurement (Daniel Reed) shortly. Happy to get a short checklist and a proposed timeline (we'd like to start the pilot by Dec 1).

Best,

Short answers up front: yes, AWS Marketplace private offers can be structured to cover a single consolidated purchaser, but multi-entity buys sometimes require buyer-side legal sign-off and a single billing entity. We'll share the exact offer link and a short checklist.

What I can do right now:
- Create a private offer for a 6-month pilot at a proposed 20% pilot discount off list, totaling up to $120k spend cap.

- Start the co-sell GTM request with AWS once we have PO/intent.

Items I need from you:
1) Confirm billing/legal entity that will accept the private offer (name + AWS account ID if possible)
2) Confirm procurement contact (Daniel?) and commercial terms (Net30/Net45)

I'll attach our instructions and SOC2 summary for procurement. If Daniel is on this thread, I can copy a draft private-offer link once I have the billing entity. Can we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow to run through acceptance steps?

Internal notes (do not forward as-is):

Stephanie — quick internal alignment before we finalize the offer. Key risk/approval items:
- Discounting: 20% pilot discount requires either SDR manager approval + Finance signoff for revenue recognition impact. We typically cap pilot discounts at 15% for Marketplace private offers unless we take a one-off credit.
- Payment terms: Net45 is OK but will push cash collection; acceptable if Finance signs off. If we need to be conservative, propose Net30 with an option for Net45 after credit approval.
- Co-sell: to get AWS seller co-sell assistance we need a signed PO + co-sell intake. That can speed buyer approvals if AWS approves the opportunity.

Recommendation: offer 15% pilot discount up front, 6-month term, and allow a one-time finance review to extend to Net45. We'll include a short clause that the private-offer is valid for 7 days to encourage quick acceptance. I can route discount approval — attaching the matrix.

Vanessa
Head of Marketplace Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
